reason: v2 passed PSNR, identity, and overshoot but its learned blend extrapolated at mid/high severity and failed gradient safety. v3 fixes a bounded piecewise-linear curve at the three explicitly unblinded development anchors.

scientific_boundary.c009: Immutable completed negative confirmatory evidence; no C009 file or verdict is replaced.
scientific_boundary.development_data: The former C009 D0 synthetic holdout is reused and tuned on as an explicitly unblinded C010 development set.
scientific_boundary.confirmation: The anchor values are development-selected. A newly acquired or never-used confirmatory set is mandatory before any efficacy claim.
scientific_boundary.claim: This pilot can establish engineering feasibility only.

base.policy: Frozen; always called with zero prompt channels.

calibration.severity_definition: mean(normalized blur prompt, normalized noise prompt)

development_evaluation.unit: Mean within physical parent before paired bootstrap
development_evaluation.primary_target: Mean v2-minus-base PSNR >= 0.10 dB and parent-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
development_evaluation.identity_target: Zero-prompt mean and p99 absolute output change <= 1e-7
